  • Active blind spot system - Protect your blind side. You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Wireless App-Connect (w/Apple CarPlay, Android Auto & MirrorLink) smart device wireless mirroring

- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Integration
- Navigation System
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with Leatherette Trim

This Sportage EX comes equipped with a responsive four-cylinder engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive, delivering a balanced combination of 25 city miles per gallon and 32 highway miles per gallon. The silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that complements the vehicles modern design and practical construction.

Inside, youll find a thoughtfully appointed cabin featuring heated front bucket seats upholstered in leatherette trim, providing comfort during those extended commutes. The front dual-zone automatic temperature control allows both driver and passenger to set their preferred climate independently. The power-adjustable driver seat and power windows offer convenient operation, while the leather steering wheel and shift knob add an elevated touch to your daily driving experience.

Technology integration is seamless with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, letting you connect your smartphone effortlessly. The navigation system, combined with the six-speaker audio setup featuring AM/FM/HD radio and SiriusXM access, keeps you connected and entertained. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls enable hands-free operation, and the trip computer provides helpful driving information at a glance.

Safety is built into every aspect of this Sportage. A comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, overhead, and rear side impact protection. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, Electronic Stability Control, traction control, brake assist, and a low tire pressure warning system work together to keep you secure in various driving conditions. The four-wheel independent suspension ensures stable handling on both smooth highways and uneven surfaces.

Practical touches throughout the cabin include heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, illuminated entry, a rear seat center armrest for added passenger comfort, vanity mirrors for both driver and passenger, and an overhead console for convenient storage. The split-folding rear seat provides flexibility for your cargo needs, while the carpeted floor mats protect your vehicles interior.

The heated front bucket seats with leather trim provide warmth during colder months, while the power driver and passenger seats allow personalized positioning for longer drives. Dual front and rear reading lights, illuminated entry, and overhead console design create an inviting atmosphere for you and your passengers.

Technology integration keeps you connected throughout your journey. Multiple airbags, including front and side impact protection, provide comprehensive occupant safety.

Tech-focused drivers who demand continuous connectivity and intuitive digital features will appreciate this SUV. It supports daily multitasking by linking easily with apps and devices, so users can manage schedules, calls, and maps while on the move. The clean CARFAX and one-owner history provide additional peace of mind for buyers who value reliability alongside cutting-edge features. This SUV is perfect for those who want to remain productive and entertained during commutes or road trips, ensuring that staying connected is effortless and secure.

Driving the Rogue SV is enhanced by technology-driven systems that optimize every aspect of performance. Its 1.5L DOHC engine and CVT with Xtronic transmission deliver smooth, adaptive responses, aided by electronic stability control and selectable drive modes tailored for varying conditions. The all-wheel drive system uses real-time data from sensors to adjust traction, while digital displays keep the driver informed about efficiency and system performance. These integrated technologies enable confident, composed handling and maximize fuel economy at 28 city and 35 highway MPG, blending traditional driving with advanced electronic oversight.

Smart safety is at the core of this SUV’s appeal, with a network of sensors and cameras providing 360-degree awareness. Features like blind spot monitoring, lane-keeping support, automatic emergency braking, and rear cross-traffic alert use real-time processing to interpret traffic flow and potential hazards, intervening as needed to help prevent collisions. The vehicle’s advanced airbag system, electronic stability control, and knee airbag add layers of protection, while automatic high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers adapt to changing environments for greater confidence, whether navigating city streets or highways.

Interior technology upgrades include dual-zone automatic climate control, a power liftgate, and an 8-way power driver seat, all accessible via digital controls. NissanConnect with six speakers creates a dynamic audio experience, while steering wheel-mounted controls allow for easy volume adjustment and track skipping. Remote keyless entry and push-button start streamline access, and the power windows and heated door mirrors offer added convenience. The cloth seats with patterned inserts combine comfort with a modern aesthetic, rounding out a cabin focused on usability and comfort.

In the tech-forward SUV segment, the Rogue SV competes directly with models like the Toyota RAV4 and Honda CR-V, yet distinguishes itself with its user-friendly NissanConnect interface and robust app ecosystem.

Does it have wireless CarPlay/Android Auto? The Rogue SV includes wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for reliable, stable smartphone integration. What driver assistance technologies are included? Key systems are automatic emergency braking, blind spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, and lane-keeping support, all designed to actively protect and inform the driver.

Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and low tire pressure warning round out your protective systems.

Exterior features include fully automatic headlights with delay-off capability, speed-sensitive wipers with variably intermittent function, a rear window wiper, and a body-color spoiler that enhance both safety and appearance.
